messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Multiple control-plane heartbeats missing in ap-southeast2. API error rate spiked to 78% over last 90s. Grouping by az shows all AZs in region affected. https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/1758765432 :rotating_light:

sasha_oncall: acknowledged — I'm on it. Starting initial triage. tagging @ryan_sre @carla_infra

ryan_sre: seeing same in dashboards, pods in region show APIServerFailed on kubelet probes. node-level metrics show kernel OOM events beginning ~T-3m.

carla_infra: checking provider control plane — their status shows network flap for ap-southeast2-pop-3. Opening support ticket now.

maria_prod: Can we confirm user impact? Any 5xx surge for hosted API keys?

monitoring-bot: Customer-facing 5xx rate for text-generate endpoints in ap-southeast2 jumped to 63%. Global failover percentage currently 12% (auto-retries/proxy).

ryan_sre: Quick checklist: 1) pause scheduled deploys in region (deploy-bot run), 2) trigger traffic-shift to ap-southeast1/cross-region pool, 3) disable autoscaler in region to avoid noisy retries.

deploy-bot: Received: pause deploys in ap-southeast2. Command: `ci pause --region ap-southeast2` — OK.

carla_infra: Provider confirms network partition affecting control plane instances in ap-southeast2-pop-3, restoring link 30-60m ETA. We'll consider draining and shifting traffic.

sasha_oncall: Initiating emergency routing policy: move new requests away from ap-southeast2. Leaving existing long-lived sessions for 5m grace. Command run: `infra route set --region ap-southeast2 --weight 0 --grace 300`

maria_prod: Notifying support & status page: "We are seeing degraded performance in APAC (ap-southeast2). Engineers are investigating; traffic being shifted to nearby regions." Draft ready, posting in 2m. :mega:

ryan_sre: Running quick probe script against model-serving frontends to verify KV cache state before failover:
```
ssh jump@ap-southeast2 -- sudo /opt/redwood/bin/check_kv_cache.sh --summary
# output: majority caches healthy but some nodes report inconsistent offsets
```

carla_infra: Given control-plane instability, recommend switching to read-only routing and enabling fallback model variant in nearby region to reduce memory pressure. Preparing rollout plan for fallback.

sasha_oncall: Escalating to oncall lead and infra PM. tagging @carla_infra for provider comms. Next steps: 1) keep traffic-shift active, 2) snapshot and cordon nodes that show OOM, 3) provider will attempt pop-level repair, 4) prepare capacity increase in ap-southeast1 if latency stays in SLO breach. Estimated customer impact: elevated latency for APAC non-critical workloads, degraded throughput for reserved Dedicated capacity pinned to ap-southeast2.

maria_prod: Noted — drafting customer message for dedicated customers with recommended action: consider failover to dedicated pools in ap-southeast1.

ryan_sre: I'll collect diagnostics (kernels, dmesg, pod statuses) and paste summary here in next 10m. If provider ETA slips, we execute cross-region evacuation plan.

monitoring-bot: Update: API error rate down to 40% since 60s after routing change. Heartbeats partially restored in one AZ. Continuing to monitor.

sasha_oncall: thanks team. Triage update saved to incident runbook and incident channel. Will maintain 15m updates or on-change. :white_check_mark:
